text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Global Stripe Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Navy
Colors: Navy
Made in USA and imported Yarn-dyed stripe has unique diamond and herringbone patterns for a tasteful update to a classic look. Back of pillow is textured, navy-colored fabric. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. 17"L x 17"W Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove pillow from packaging and let it fully expand.
